notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 82-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.43, bnp 1637, creatinine 0.72, hemoglobin 13.5, platelets 290, sodium 140, wbc 8; vitals dbp 66-69, heart_rate 79-83, map 88-92, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-18, sbp 131-139, spo2 95-97, temp 36.6-36.8
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral effusions; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Furosemide 40 mg IV; Transthoracic echo: LVEF 30%, global hypokinesis
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. CHF.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.74, hemoglobin 13.6, platelets 287, sodium 140, wbc 8; vitals dbp 65-68, heart_rate 78-83, map 88-90, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-18, sbp 134-139, spo2 95-97, temp 36.7-36.8
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Furosemide 40 mg IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. CHF. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 82-year-old male, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. CHF. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
